description: Twill: a JS/TS syntax-sugar language with trailing closures, guards, block-scoped defer, build plugins, type checking, and editor support.
name: twill-workspace

scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:package && pnpm editor:package
scripts.editor:build: pnpm --filter twill... run build && node scripts/verify-editor-plugin.mjs
scripts.editor:package: pnpm editor:build && node scripts/package-editor.mjs && node scripts/verify-vsix.mjs
scripts.example:check: node packages/twill/dist/cli.js check -p examples/basic/tsconfig.json && node packages/twill/dist/cli.js check -p examples/general/tsconfig.json && node packages/twill/dist/cli.js check -p examples/defer/tsconfig.json && node packages/twill/dist/cli.js check -p examples/react/tsconfig.json && node packages/twill/dist/cli.js check -p examples/vue/tsconfig.json && node packages/twill/dist/cli.js check -p examples/mixed/tsconfig.json
